# F7: particles and visual effects {#sec-fg-particles-vfx}

The engine draws smoke, dust, fire and spray from one particle source. A
mod sets the source input. The engine runs the solver. This page covers the
config classes AEE re-declares, the four source calls, the ParticleArray
shape, and the three faults that break the picture.

## What works

- `CfgCloudlets` defines the particle effects as smoke, dust, explosion and
  fire. The class starts at line 2901 of the derapified `Dta/bin.pbo`
  config. {src:pbo:Dta/bin.pbo:2901}
- A `CfgCloudlets` class carries the fields `particleShape`, `particleType`,
  `interval`, `lifeTime`, `moveVelocity[]`, `rubbing`, `onTimerScript` and
  `beforeDestroyScript`. {src:cfg:CfgCloudlets.particleShape}
- AEE declares three cloudlets in `addons/particles/config.cpp`:
  `AEE_SupersonicTrace`, `AEE_SandCloud` and `AEE_SnowCloud`.
  {src:script:addons/particles/config.cpp}
- `CfgCloudletShapes` maps a shape name to the model. The shipped config
  maps `cloudletSmoke` to `default.p3d`. The class starts at line 7423.
  {src:pbo:Dta/bin.pbo:7423}
- `CfgLights` defines the dynamic lights. Each light sets `color[]`,
  `ambient[]` and `brightness[]`. The class starts at line 3466.
  {src:pbo:Dta/bin.pbo:3466}
- The light falloff is the `class Attenuation` block with the four terms
  `start`, `constant`, `linear` and `quadratic`. The engine reference
  records the block as a `CfgLights` field. {src:cfg:CfgLights.Attenuation}
  In the shipped config the block sits on the world lighting light at line
  14358. {src:pbo:Dta/bin.pbo:14358}
- `setParticleParams` sets the whole ParticleArray. {src:cmd:setParticleParams}
- `setParticleRandom` sets the per-particle random spread.
  {src:cmd:setParticleRandom}
- `setParticleCircle` makes a circular emitter.
  {src:cmd:setParticleCircle}
- `setDropInterval` sets the seconds between emissions.
  {src:cmd:setDropInterval}
- The shipped emitter builds the array in
  `addons/particles/functions/particle/fnc_particlePipelineEmit.sqf`.
  {src:script:addons/particles/functions/particle/fnc_particlePipelineEmit.sqf}
- The array has **22 live elements, indices 0 to 21**, in this order:
  0 shapeName, 1 animationName, 2 type, 3 timerPeriod, 4 lifetime,
  5 position, 6 moveVelocity, 7 rotationVelocity, 8 weight, 9 volume,
  10 rubbing, 11 size, 12 color, 13 animationPhase, 14 randomDirectionPeriod,
  15 randomDirectionIntensity, 16 onTimer, 17 beforeDestroy, 18 object,
  19 angle, 20 onSurface, 21 bounceOnSurface.
  {src:script:docs/wiki/research/particle-array-spec.md}

## What does not work

- The animation element, index 1, is obsolete. A value throws the RPT error
  "Skeletal animation not supported for particles". The shipped emitter
  keeps it empty.
  {src:script:docs/wiki/research/particle-array-spec.md}
- The particle solver is engine-closed. A mod sets the input fields only.
  {src:cfg:CfgCloudlets}
- A per-particle light does not work. The light list loads once, so a mod
  cannot add a per-object light at run time. {src:cfg:CfgLights}
- `setParticleClass` does not evaluate a simple expression inside the config
  class. Some vanilla classes are therefore unusable from script.
  {src:cmd:setParticleClass}

## Limitations

- The particle solver is engine-closed. No config field changes the motion
  integration. {src:cfg:CfgCloudlets}
- The array shape is fixed. The engine documents 24 elements, but the
  shipped emitter truncates the array at index 21 and lets the engine
  default the rest.
  {src:script:docs/wiki/research/particle-array-spec.md}
- The particle count is capped by the client `particlesQuality` setting. A
  mod cannot raise it. {src:cmd:setParticleParams}
- An attached source is bounded by the object view distance.
  {src:script:docs/wiki/research/particle-array-spec.md}
- The visual plume is out of scope for the CBRN dispersion decision. That
  model publishes the state a future particle effect would render.
  {src:adr:ADR-038}

## Breaks visually

- A wrong `particleShape` frame range shows the wrong frame. The shape
  element carries `[p3dPath, nth, index, count, loop]`, so the frame
  index and the frame count set the drawn frame.
  {src:script:docs/wiki/research/particle-array-spec.md}
- A `position` that is not a selection name or a vector fails. The element
  accepts a Position or a String that names an object selection.
  {src:script:addons/particles/functions/particle/fnc_particlePipelineEmit.sqf}
- An uncapped emitter count floods the frame. `setDropInterval` sets the
  rate as `1 / interval`. {src:cmd:setDropInterval}
- `bounceOnSurface` at a value such as 0.6 has a significant performance
  cost against -1. The engine documents the cost.
  {src:script:docs/wiki/research/particle-array-spec.md}
